steps.question: Does this call read project source, config, tests or docs from the filesystem to show contents or return rewritten source instead of using the read tool? Count cat/head/tail/sed/awk and Python read_text/open or Node readFile/readFileSync, including ad hoc scripts that read source, transform or compile it and print the result for a later edit. Piping output or not writing a file does not exempt it. Answer no for content fetched over the network, such as gh api raw READMEs or files, curl or wget, even piped to head or cat; git commands such as git diff, show, log or blame, which review changes the read tool cannot show; computation on inline text or stdin without a project-file read; rg/grep searches, listings, metadata/counts, structured-data queries for specific values, logs, temporary files, binary analysis, and normal builds/tests/formatters/compilers/generators reading their own inputs.

then.text: Chauffeur: Read project files with the read tool, not shell printers or Python/Node file reads, including scripts that print transformed source. Use build tools for compilation and edit or patch tools for changes.
